open_questions: Can a warp-level reduction replace the full shared-memory tree without losing performance?

Is one block per row appropriate across all hidden sizes?

Can vectorized BF16 access reduce memory instruction overhead?
Can the second full row traversal be improved without increasing register pressure?
Should different hidden sizes use different CUDA strategies?
